name: inv-1-no-rfc8693-token-exchange
description: INV-1 (FR-002, FR-003; plan 2026-11-24-agent-identity-redesign): no production source performs an RFC 8693 token exchange. Only an agent's own identity federates into Entra; a human-subject token is never exchanged at the realm or presented as a federated assertion. Flags the token-exchange grant URN and string-literal subject_token / subject_token_type form parameters. Tests are excluded so they may assert the absence, and scripts/check-identity-docs.ts is excluded by exact path: its doc-lint banned-phrase table names these strings, as plain literals, to find them in docs (plan loop-back 15).
fixHint: Do not build an RFC 8693 token exchange. Agent credentials come from RealmAssertionMint.mintFederationAssertion (client_credentials, scope "entra-exchange <capability>") and EntraAgentAuthority; user-origin app runs record the initiator for attribution only, and delegated runs use Entra on-behalf-of through the agent identity (see ADR-0094 and plan 2026-11-24-agent-identity-redesign AD-1).
